history.title: Premiere polish, Cursor Timeline, new Person & Timeline animations

changes.text: Premiere: every button icon now uses the same thin Material style as After Effects
Align: bigger anchor point grid; the anchor icon style switcher moved to Settings > Theme under Anchor grid style
Premiere Color: palette color boxes fill with Ramp (both colors the same) - no Tint
Preview left / settings right everywhere: drag the divider to resize the live preview, set the spacing in Settings > Look & feel
SFX: one clean top bar - search, folder dropdown, volume, rescan and settings; boxes show only the name
Trim Paths: the live preview shows a square, or the selected shape layer / mask itself
Cursor: new Cursor Timeline - add moves, clicks, drags, hovers and waits, watch the live preview and add it to the comp / sequence
Person: 45 new avatar and team animations
Timeline: 51 new templates
FX Search opens inside the panel without the window title bar; Premiere footer buttons removed

history.title: Big update: common settings, new icons, AI / Search / Person elements

changes.text: Settings: one common Animations switch (Off / Hover / Always) and one Size (Small / Medium / Large) for every tab - lots of separate options removed
License: 1 computer per license
Align tab: Move & Properties shows the selected layer / clip and lets you edit Position, Scale, Rotation, Opacity and Anchor live (After Effects + Premiere Pro)
Premiere Color: color boxes fill with Ramp (both colors the same) and gradients use Ramp with both gradient colors - no more Tint
New thin Material Symbols icons on every tab, button and popup - no glow, no drop shadow
Export: settings button next to Export - resolution, frame rate, bitrate, render quality, image size, JPG quality, GIF and audio settings
All popups are smaller, follow the panel size and show the live preview on the left with the settings on the right
Elements: 3 new tabs - Person (58), Search (62) and AI Mode (105 animations: AI chats, prompts, Nano Banana style image edits, voice orbs, agents ...)
Chat tab: 41 new chat and comment styles, shown in one row with a slider
Editor Mode > Guides: platform presets open in a slide panel from the right, toggles in one top row, color next to Opacity
Premiere 3D Carousel: 46 new templates (105 total) and drag clips / footage straight from the Project panel
Premiere SFX: folder dropdown next to search, rescan + settings next to the volume, settings panel with insert position, view, box width / height and duplicates, boxes show only the SFX name
Number Counter live preview in After Effects
Carousel presets in one row with a slider (After Effects)
FX Search window opens once instead of restarting while it loads; faster panel start (3D Carousel thumbnails load when the tab opens)
Premiere anchor box sits inside its card
